title: Larkspur Credit Cards Cash Back Earning and Redemption Table
content:
Each card in the Larkspur Credit Cards line-up earns cash back on purchases at a rate set for each rewards category. The base rate covers purchases that are not in a bonus category. A rate of 0 means the card earns no rewards. Rates are percentages of the purchase; the minimum redemption is in USD.

## Earning rates and redemption terms by card

| Term | Larkspur Secured Visa | Larkspur Classic Visa | Larkspur Cash Back Visa | Larkspur Balance Transfer Visa Platinum | Larkspur Cash Back Visa Signature | Larkspur Travel Rewards Visa Signature |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Base cash back (purchases not in a bonus category), percent | 1 | 0 | 1.5 | 0 | 2 | 1.5 |
| Grocery, percent | 1 | 0 | 3 | 0 | 2 | 1.5 |
| Dining, percent | 1 | 0 | 3 | 0 | 2 | 3 |
| Gas, percent | 1 | 0 | 2 | 0 | 2 | 1.5 |
| Travel, percent | 1 | 0 | 1.5 | 0 | 2 | 4 |
| Smallest redemption | 25 | 0 | 25 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Ways to redeem | statement credit; deposit to a linked bank account | statement credit; deposit to a linked bank account | statement credit; deposit to a linked bank account | statement credit; deposit to a linked bank account | statement credit; deposit to a linked bank account | statement credit; deposit to a linked bank account |
| Unredeemed rewards forfeited when the account closes or is charged off | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Notes

- **Cards that earn nothing.** The Larkspur Classic Visa and the Larkspur Balance Transfer Visa Platinum earn 0 in every category. A base rate of 0 means no rewards are earned.
- **Flat-rate cards.** The Larkspur Secured Visa earns 1 percent in every category and the Larkspur Cash Back Visa Signature earns 2 percent in every category, so on these two cards the category of a purchase does not change its rate.
- **Category cards.** The Larkspur Cash Back Visa is strongest on grocery and dining (3 percent). The Larkspur Travel Rewards Visa Signature is strongest on travel (4 percent), then dining (3 percent).
- **Smallest redemption.** A redemption on the Larkspur Secured Visa or the Larkspur Cash Back Visa must be at least 25. The other cards show 0.

## Hypothetical rate look-up

The purchase amount here is invented. A dining purchase of 100.00 earns:

| Card | Dining rate | Cash back on 100.00 |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Secured Visa | 1 | 1.00 |
| Larkspur Cash Back Visa | 3 | 3.00 |
| Larkspur Cash Back Visa Signature | 2 | 2.00 |
| Larkspur Travel Rewards Visa Signature | 3 | 3.00 |
| Larkspur Classic Visa, Larkspur Balance Transfer Visa Platinum | 0 | 0.00 |
